dataset_slug.description: Public dataset identity. Use lowercase ASCII letters, digits, and single hyphen separators. Do not encode local paths, private names, or release details in the slug.

release_id.description: Published release identifier for the first public cycle, formatted as release-YYYYMMDD-NNN. The identifier names an immutable release package outside this registry.

active_release.description: Each published dataset must declare exactly one active_release value. The active release is explicit registry data and must not be inferred from file scanning, latest runs, timestamps, directory order, or fallback artifacts.

public_metadata.title: Telco Customer Churn
public_metadata.summary: Customer churn prediction dataset for a telecommunications provider. Predicts whether a customer will churn based on service usage and account features.

public_metadata.title: Bank Marketing
public_metadata.summary: A binary classification dataset for predicting client subscription to a term deposit in a bank marketing campaign. Used to validate Atlas DataFlow multi-dataset publication mechanics.
